tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
High-Performance 4-Port EPON OLT – Advanced Fiber Network Solution

Ultra-Fast, Scalable & Reliable EPON OLT for High-Speed Fiber Networks

The 4-Port EPON OLT is a powerful and scalable fiber network solution, designed to provide high-speed data transmission, seamless connectivity, and reliable performance for FTTX, ISP, and enterprise networks. Supporting 10 Gigabit Ethernet (10G) speeds, this OLT (Optical Line Terminal) ensures efficient data distribution to ONUs and ONTs, making it ideal for fiber-to-the-home (FTTH), fiber-to-the-business (FTTB), and fiber-to-the-premises (FTTP) deployments.


With a maximum transmission distance of 20km, support for 256 ONUs, and Dynamic Bandwidth Allocation (DBA) technology, this EPON OLT delivers optimized network performance, minimal latency, and efficient bandwidth management.


Key Features 

  • Ultra-Fast 10G Ethernet Ports – Delivers lightning-fast data transmission with 4 high-speed SFP PON ports.
  • Supports Up to 256 ONUs – Maximum 1:64 splitter ratio for extensive fiber network coverage.
  • Long-Distance Transmission – Supports up to 20km reach for extended fiber deployments.
  • Seamless ONU Compatibility – Works with multiple EPON & XPON ONUs from different vendors.
  • Advanced Bandwidth Management – Features Dynamic Bandwidth Allocation (DBA) for efficient network optimization.
  • Flexible Network Integration – Supports IEEE 802.3, IEEE 802.3u, and IEEE 802.3ab protocols.
  • Robust Security & Encryption – Includes AES-128 encryption for secure data transmission.
  • Comprehensive Network Management – Offers Web, SNMP, CLI, and GUI-based remote monitoring & management.
  • 1U Rack-Mount Design – Compact and efficient with a built-in cooling fan for better heat dissipation.
  • Low Power Consumption – Energy-efficient 20W power usage with AC 100-240V input.


Technical Specifications

Port Configuration
  • 4 x SFP PON Ports – Supports 1000M fiber connections
  • 4 x 1000M RJ45 Uplink Ports – Ensures high-speed uplink connectivity
  • 2 x 1000M SFP Uplink Ports – Ideal for flexible fiber network integration
  • 2 x 10G SFP+ Uplink Ports – Supports ultra-fast 10 Gigabit networking
  • 1 x Management Port (RJ45) – For easy network configuration
  • 1 x Console Port (RJ45) – Allows direct access for system debugging
  • 1 x USB Port – For additional management and maintenance


Network Performance & Capacity

  • Max Splitter Ratio – 1:64 (Total 256 ONUs supported)
  • Transmission Distance – Up to 20km (with a 1:32 splitter ratio)
  • Upstream Interface – 2 x Gigabit RJ45 & 2 x Gigabit SFP Optical Ports
  • PON Port Power – Optical Power Output: +2.5 to +7 dBm
  • Receiving Sensitivity – -27 dBm
  • MAC Address Table – 8K entries


EPON & Network Management Features

  • Fully Compliant with IEEE 802.3ah – Industry-standard EPON support
  • Supports IGMP Snooping & Proxy – Optimized multicast traffic management
  • VLAN & QoS Support – 4096 VLANs, QinQ, and IEEE 802.1P priority scheduling
  • ONU Auto-Discovery & Plug-and-Play Registration – Seamless device integration
  • Remote Management & Monitoring – Web GUI, SNMP, CLI, Serial Port Management
  • Advanced Security – ONU MAC filtering, auto MAC binding, and AES-128 encryption


Physical & Power Specifications

  • Power Supply – AC 100-240V
  • Power Consumption – 20W (Energy Efficient Design)
  • Operating Temperature – -10 to 55°C
  • Storage Temperature – -40 to 80°C
  • Humidity Range – 5% to 90% (No Condensation)
  • Equipment Size – 44mm (H) × 276mm (W) × 200mm (D)


Ideal Applications

  • FTTX & FTTH Deployments – Provides high-speed fiber internet access to homes and businesses.
  • ISP & Telecom Networks – Ensures reliable and scalable connectivity for large-scale networks.
  • Enterprise & Data Centers – Supports robust fiber-optic infrastructure for high-performance networking.
  • Campus & Smart City Networks – Enables seamless fiber-optic connectivity for large-area coverage.
  • IPTV & VoIP Services – Ensures smooth transmission of IPTV, VoIP, and high-speed data services.


Why Choose This EPON OLT?

  • Blazing-Fast 10G Ethernet – Ensures high-speed, reliable data transmission.
  • Scalable & Future-Proof – Supports 256 ONUs with up to 20km transmission.
  • Seamless Compatibility – Works with EPON & XPON ONUs from different vendors.
  • Advanced Traffic Management – QoS, IGMP Snooping, VLAN stacking, and priority queue scheduling.
  • Secure & Reliable – Features AES-128 encryption, MAC filtering, and real-time alarm detection.
  • Effortless Network Management – Web GUI, SNMP, CLI, and remote configuration support.
  • Energy-Efficient & Durable – Low 20W power consumption with a 1U rack-mountable design.
